title: ui-quality 0.9.0 false positives seen on compratuentrada (2026-11-05)
notes: A run over `/`, an event page, `/conciertos/madrid` and `/admin` at 1440
and 390 px reported: `text-clipped` and `text-occlusion` on an `sr-only`
skip link ("Saltar al contenido"), which is hidden by design until
focused; `time-without-datetime` on the "7 días" / "30 días" period filter
links, which name a range, not a moment; and `nested-cards` plus
`ragged-column` treating a bordered inline-flex link button inside a card
as a card and as a column. Next step: add a fixture per case under
`packages/ui-quality/tests` that reproduces each finding, then exempt
`sr-only` (clip/1px) elements, duration phrases without a date, and inline
result: ui-quality 0.9.0 false positives seen on compratuentrada (2026-11-05)
evidence: packages/ui-quality: pnpm test 145 files, 571 tests pass; pnpm check:ci exit 0. cli.link-button covers the clean page (visually hidden skip links, period filter, link button in a card) and a dirty control (a clip that shows its box, a tall linked card in a card); rules/fields covers period phrases against real relative timestamps. ragged-column on the link button was not reproduced by the fixture, so no change was made for it.
